compactMessages.Name: Compact Messages
compactMessages.Hint: If enabled, changelog messages are limited to a single line and expand when hovered over, focused or tapped. Useful for keeping the chat log tidy.

messageStyle.Name: Message Style
messageStyle.Hint: How changelog messages are coloured. 'Tinted' keeps your system's chat card with a light tint and a coloured stripe (default). 'Solid' fills the line with its colour and uses white text. 'System card' keeps the system's chat card unchanged apart from a coloured stripe.

simpleOutput.Name: Simplified Output
simpleOutput.Hint: If enabled, changelog messages only show the change (e.g. '+5') instead of also showing the old and new value (e.g. '10 → 15'). Applies to messages posted after the change.

messageVisibility.Name: Message Visibility
messageVisibility.Hint: Controls who can see changelog messages. 'GM only' whispers exclusively to GMs. 'GM + Owners' whispers to GMs and the owning player(s) (default). 'Everyone' posts a public message visible to all players and GMs. 'Player only' whispers to all non-GM players. For NPCs, the audience is further refined by the NPC Message Audience setting unless Visibility is set to 'GM only' or 'Player only'.

npcAudience.Name: NPC Message Audience
npcAudience.Hint: Controls who can see changelog messages for NPC actors. 'GM only' whispers exclusively to GMs. 'GM + Owners' whispers to GMs and the owning player(s) (default). 'Everyone' posts a public message visible to all players and GMs. Only applies when Message Visibility is set to 'GM + Owners' or 'Everyone'.

trackCurrency.Name: Track Currency
trackCurrency.Hint: If enabled, the module will monitor and log changes to actor and container currency.

trackItemChanges.Name: Track Item Changes
trackItemChanges.Hint: If enabled, the module will monitor and log changes to items.

trackDeletedMessages.Name: Track Deleted Chat Messages
trackDeletedMessages.Hint: If enabled, when a player deletes a chat message, a copy of it is whispered to the GM(s).

protectChangelogMessages.Name: Protect Changelog Messages
protectChangelogMessages.Hint: If enabled, players cannot delete or edit changelog messages, so changes (e.g. HP gains) cannot be hidden from the GM. GMs can still delete them.

trackEquipUnequip.Name: Track Equip / Unequip
trackEquipUnequip.Hint: If enabled, the module will log when items are equipped or unequipped on an actor.

trackActiveEffects.Name: Track Active Effects
trackActiveEffects.Hint: If enabled, the module will log when Active Effects are added, removed, enabled, or disabled on an actor.

nameBlacklist.Name: Ignored Names / Blacklist
nameBlacklist.Hint: Comma-separated list of item and Active Effect names to ignore from changelogs (case-insensitive, e.g. 'Aura of Protection, Torch'). Supports wildcards (*) and regex (/pattern/).

customTrackersMenu.Name: Custom Tracked Values
customTrackersMenu.Label: Configure
customTrackersMenu.Hint: Configure custom actor data paths to track (e.g. Wounds, Fatigue) along with their messages, colors, and icons.

importExportMenu.Name: Import / Export Settings
importExportMenu.Label: Import / Export
importExportMenu.Hint: Export all module settings and custom tracker configurations to a JSON file, or import settings from a previously exported file.

autoDetectPaths.Name: Auto-Detect HP Paths
autoDetectPaths.Hint: If enabled, the module attempts to automatically determine the correct data paths for HP and other attributes based on the active system. Disable this to manually configure paths below.

hpPath.Name: HP Value Path
hpPath.Hint: Manual System Data Path for HP Value.

tempHpPath.Name: Temp HP Path
tempHpPath.Hint: Manual System Data Path for Temporary HP.

tempHpMaxPath.Name: Temp HP Max Path
tempHpMaxPath.Hint: Manual System Data Path for Temporary HP Max.

currencyBasePath.Name: Currency Base Path (Adv)
currencyBasePath.Hint: Manual System Data Path for Currency. Use this to override the default detection if needed.

trackDnd5eInspiration.Name: Track Inspiration
trackDnd5eInspiration.Hint: If enabled, logs when a character gains or uses Heroic Inspiration.

trackDnd5eDeathSaves.Name: Track Death Saves
trackDnd5eDeathSaves.Hint: If enabled, logs successes and failures for Death Saving Throws on characters.

trackDnd5eSpellPrep.Name: Track Spell Preparation
trackDnd5eSpellPrep.Hint: If enabled, logs when spells are prepared or unprepared on characters.

trackDnd5eSpellSlots.Name: Track Spell Slots
trackDnd5eSpellSlots.Hint: If enabled, logs when spell slots are expended or regained.

trackDnd5eHitDice.Name: Track Hit Dice
trackDnd5eHitDice.Hint: If enabled, logs when characters expend or regain Hit Dice.

trackDnd5eXP.Name: Track Experience Points
trackDnd5eXP.Hint: If enabled, logs when a character gains or loses Experience Points.

trackMorkBorgAbilities.Name: Track Abilities
trackMorkBorgAbilities.Hint: If enabled, logs when a character increases or decreases Abilities scores.

trackMorkBorgOmens.Name: Track Omens
trackMorkBorgOmens.Hint: If enabled, logs when a character gains or uses Omens.

trackMorkBorgPowers.Name: Track Powers
trackMorkBorgPowers.Hint: If enabled, logs when a character uses or recovers Powers.

Chat.OnlyGMDelete: Changelog messages can only be deleted by a GM.
Chat.OnlyGMEdit: Changelog messages can only be edited by a GM.

Trackers.Title: Custom Tracked Values
Trackers.Intro: Define custom data paths to track on your actors. Paths must be valid properties on the Actor's data (e.g., system.attributes.fatigue.value).
Trackers.Placeholders: Formatting Placeholders: You can use {name}, {old}, {new}, and {diff} in your gain/loss messages to make them dynamic. Note that boolean (true/false) properties are treated numerically (1 or 0).
Trackers.Icons: Icons: Type a FontAwesome class (e.g., fa-solid fa-droplet) or click the file picker icon to browse for an image.
Trackers.Docs: Read the full documentation and examples on GitHub
Trackers.Empty: No custom tracked resources defined. Click the + icon to add one.
Trackers.ExportHint: Export custom trackers to a JSON file
Trackers.ImportHint: Import custom trackers from a JSON file
Trackers.ImportPrompt:
Found {count} custom tracker(s) in {file}.

How would you like to apply them to your current list?
Trackers.NoneFound: No custom tracker configurations found in the selected file.
Trackers.Imported: Imported {count} custom tracker(s). Click "Save Changes" to save.

ImportExport.Title: Nik's Tiny Change Logs: Import / Export Settings
ImportExport.Intro: Export your Nik's Tiny Change Logs configuration to a portable JSON file for backup or transfer between worlds, or import an existing configuration.
ImportExport.ExportDesc: Exports all module settings (visibility, feature toggles, blacklist, and system trackers) and all custom tracked resource definitions.
ImportExport.ImportDesc: Upload a .json file exported from Nik's Tiny Change Logs. You will be prompted with a preview of found settings before changes are applied.
ImportExport.ModeMerge: Merge — Keep existing custom trackers and append new ones
ImportExport.ErrorNotObject: Invalid JSON data: payload is not an object or array.
ImportExport.ErrorOtherModule: Invalid configuration file: file belongs to module "{module}", not "{expected}".
ImportExport.ErrorNothingFound: No recognizable settings or custom tracker definitions found in the file.
ImportExport.ConfirmTitle: Import Nik's Tiny Change Logs Settings
ImportExport.ConfirmContent:

Import and apply these configurations to your world now?
ImportExport.SkippedInvalid: Some settings had invalid values and were skipped: {keys}
